ondisk_compressed_bytes_basis: exact: sum of every *-Data.db file size
logical_uncompressed_bytes_basis: sum of CompressionInfo.db dataLength (self-validated against the offsets array); uncompressed SSTables contribute their Data.db size. layout=with_max_compressed_length
arrow_wire_bytes_basis: NOT measurable from the corpus: comes from flight-loadgen bytes_per_s, which is Arrow buffer CAPACITY bytes, not compressed gRPC-on-the-wire bytes
